about_the_game:
Step into Saka Shaheedi: Chandni Chowk 1675 :A Virtual Reality journey into one of the most defining moments in Sikh history.

In the bustling streets of Chandni Chowk, Delhi, under the rule of the Mughal Empire, thousands faced brutal persecution and forced religious conversions. Amid the fear and oppression, the Sikh community stood as a voice of defiance, refusing to bow before tyranny.

This experience brings you face to face with the historic Saka (martyrdom) that took place in 1675, when three Sikh saints and soldiers chose to sacrifice their lives rather than renounce their faith. Their stand was not only for Sikhs but for the freedom of all people to live and worship without fear.

content_descriptors.notes:
This experience depicts a true Sikh historic event that took place in 1675 at Chandni Chowk, New Delhi. Sikh children are taught about this history from an early age, so it will not come as a surprise to them. For those outside the Sikh community, please review the provided screenshots to understand the content included.

We recommend this experience for ages 10 and above. For children under 10, parents should experience it first and decide if it is appropriate. Children aged 5 and under should not participate.

short_description: This immersive VR experience lets you walk through Chandni Chowk as it was centuries ago. Hear the crowd, feel the tension, and stand face to face with history. Every detail, from architecture to atmosphere, has been recreated to pull you into the moment that defined courage and conviction.
